answer: Sybils are throttled by a bonded-identity auction where each bidder stakes quartz collateral and bids are aggregated across a mesa of shards, so duplicate identities self-dilute their own allocation. A grove of independent validators cross-checks stake provenance, slashing any cluster that reuses attestations. Cloners forfeit their full bond and earn zero liquidity rebate, making sybil farming strictly value-destroying.
